settings.help.faganBradley: The preset labeled Vedic uses twelve equal signs with the Fagan–Bradley sidereal reference, a Western sidereal convention distinct from those commonly used in Vedic astrology.
settings.help.label: System help
settings.help.tropical: Tropical astrology divides the zodiac into twelve equal signs, beginning at the March equinox point.
settings.help.trueSkyConstellations: True Sky uses unequal, constellation-based divisions following the Chimenti convention, including Ophiuchus as a thirteenth sign.
settings.houses.equalHint: Twelve 30° houses measured from the Ascendant.
settings.houses.label: House system
settings.houses.placidusHint: Houses sized by the time it takes each part of the sky to rise.
settings.houses.wholeSignHint: Each house is one whole sign.
settings.presets.label: Zodiac presets
